name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
summary: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

name: Jötunn's Greed
summary: Jötunn's Greed is a fast-paced extraction-looter where you raid villages and grow your clan with the loot you acquire. Build up enough power to take on the giant that wronged your people!

name: Jönssonligan: Jakten på Mjölner
summary: Jönssonligan: Jakten på Mjölner is a puzzle-solving point-and-click adventure game based on the Swedish comedy films which uses the same characters but a new plot.

name: Jönssonligan: Går på djupet
summary: Jönssonligan: Går på Djupet is a puzzle-solving point-and-click adventure game based on the Swedish comedic films which uses the same characters but a new plot

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Collector's Edition
summary:
Unleash your might with the Collector’s Edition of Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel! This premium bundle includes:

- the full game,
- the Conan DLC,
- Heimdal’s Bifrost Armor Pack,
- Tyr’s Mythical Armor Pack,
- the stirring Official Soundtrack,
- and a stunning Digital Artbook.

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Founders Edition
summary:
This exclusive edition includes:

- Odin's Legendary Armor Pack, featuring stunning legendary skins for every character
- Beautifully crafted Digital Artbook
- Epic Official Soundtrack
- The Full Game

Immerse yourself in the mythic chaos and claim the ultimate rewards as one of the game's earliest champions!

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Odin's Legendary Armor Pack
summary: Unleash the divine fury of Asgard with Odin's Legendary Armor Pack. Transform your favorite heroes in Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel with exclusive, awe-inspiring armor sets that embody the might of the Allfather himself.

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Tyr's Mythical Armor Pack
summary:
Harness the fearless resolve of Tyr with his Mythical Armor Pack. Transform your heroes in Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel with valor-forged armor sets that embody justice, discipline, and unwavering strength.

This downloadable content contains:

- Warbound Battlegear for Berserker
- Enigmatic Robes for Seeress
- Wildfire Shroud for Flame Sister
- Godstalker Armor for Revenant
- Plate of Justice for Warden
- Executioner's Regalia for Kinslayer

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Freyr's Gilded Armor Pack
summary: Earn the favor of bountiful Freyr through Freyr's Gilded Armor Pack. Clothe your heroes in Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel with the finest golden trims and bountiful filigrees showing the utmost prosperity of the God of Kingship.

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Heimdal's Bifrost Armor Pack
summary:
Step into the light with Heimdal’s Bifrost Armor Pack. Equip your heroes in Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel with radiant armor inspired by the guardian of the rainbow bridge, blending dazzling brilliance with unbreakable defense.

This downloadable content contains:

Chromatic Battlegear for Berserker
Alchemist Robes for Seeress
Death-cross Armor for Revenant
Quicksilver Shroud for Flame Sister
Enchanted Plate for Warden
Gatekeeper Regalia for Kinslayer

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Conan Edition
summary: Conan Edition bundles the acclaimed roguelike survivor Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel with the massive Conan the Barbarian DLC. Play as the legendary Cimmerian , master three brutal sub-classes , and conquer the treacherous Sands of Stygia. With the high-stakes God of Fate system you have everything you need to tread the jeweled thrones of the Earth.
